author: kycrafft
body:
Just some suggestions. If you don't want to read this whole think, just spare me the trouble and leave. Thanks. 

Nebula:

Lots of people find TDM kind of annoying...it's not so much different from nexus. My suggestion is to convert 1/2 of the TDM maps to pot pvp. 

Obviously this his is gonna have some drawbacks, but it doesn't have to be full on OP pot pvp, just some iron armor and health pots or something. Playing Fantasy TDM/Potpvp was fun for a lot of players so why not take this as an opportunity to spice up TDM?

Nexus: (FFA)

I suggested this earlier, but yeah. FFA pls. 


Nexus: (Custom classes)

This may not be 100% original but I think it is a neat idea. There aren't a whole lot of options for classes in Nexus. I think it would be really cool if before game you could use points (given to you by levels) to create your own classes by choosing things like sword types, armor and enchantments. 

This is is basicly my idea. You get an eye of ender in the spectator load out. Click it to open a menu. You start of with 25 points. 

Example of prices:

Swords: 
Wood axe: 5 points
Wood sword: 8 points
Stone sword: 10 points 
Iron sword: 12 points
Diamond Sword: 14 points
Sharpness: 3 points per level, max of level 2
Fire aspect 1: 5 points
Knockback: 2 points per level

Bows: 
Bow: 7 points
Punch 1: 4 points
Flame 1: 5 points
Power: 3 points per level, max of 3
Infinity: 7 points
16 arrows: 3 points
32 arrows: 5 points
40 arrows: 6 points

Armor:
anything with 1/2 armor bar: 2 points
anything with 1 armor bar: 4 points
anything with 1 1/2 armor bars: 6 points
(And so on, each 1/2 armor bar is worth 2 points)
Protection: 2 per level, max of level 2
Projectile protection: 1 per level, max of 2
Feather falling: 1 per level
Thorns: 2 per level

Effects:
Speed: level 1 = 4 points; 2 = 9 points
Strenght (OP, NOPE)
Resistance: level 1 = 4 points
Regen: level 1 = 3 points
Invisiblity: (must have 1+ piece of armor) 10 points
Slowness: (free and you get 3 more points)
Mining fatigue: (free and you get 2 more points)

^^^long example list

Extra rules for this game idea:
TDM or FFA 
Pre set classes available 
+1 point per every 8 levels you gain 
You can only customize your class before a game or in spec mode to stop people from spending the game doing nothing trying to make a class 
You have 4 custom kit slots to edit, donators have 5,6,7 respectively
You can do /info (player name) to find out their classes


These are just ideas and I don't expect them to get added, especially the last one (coding nightmare). Thanks for reading
